description: This file defines the Orleans grain communication interface IPersonGrain and related data structures such as PersonAttributes and GenderType, used for person-related operations within an Orleans distributed application.

classes.name: GenderType
classes.description: Enumeration representing gender options, either Male or Female.

classes.name: PersonAttributes
classes.description: Serializable data class holding personal attributes such as first name, last name, and gender.

methods.name: RegisterBirth
methods.description: Registers a new person's birth with the provided attributes.

methods.name: Marry
methods.description: Initiates a marriage between the current grain and a spouse grain.

methods.name: RunTentativeConfirmedStateTest
methods.description: Runs internal tests related to tentative and confirmed states.
